name: biletimial
description: Search flight tickets without signing in. Total prices including taxes and service fee are listed cheapest first; the flight you choose is booked and paid on biletimial.com. / Uçak biletlerini giriş yapmadan arayın; vergiler ve hizmet bedeli dahil toplam fiyatlar en ucuzdan başlayarak listelenir, seçtiğiniz uçuş biletimial.com'da satın alınır.

author.name: BD Seyahat ve Turizm Acentesi LTD ŞTİ

interface.longDescription:
Search flight tickets with BiletimiAl without leaving ChatGPT, without signing in and without creating an account, then book the flight you like on biletimial.com.

Ask in everyday language, in English or Turkish: one-way or round-trip, any date, number of adults, children and infants, economy or business. BiletimiAl searches current offers and lists them cheapest first. Each offer shows the airline, flight numbers, local departure and arrival times, flight duration, number of stops, baggage allowance and fare package; refund and change conditions are shown on biletimial.com before payment.

Prices are totals for all passengers, including taxes and the service fee, and match the price on biletimial.com. The "Seç" (Select) button on each offer opens that flight's booking page on biletimial.com, where you enter passenger details and complete payment. The app does not book or take payments in the chat and does not ask for personal data. Offers are held for about 20 minutes; after that, the same search opens with current prices.

Focused on flights to, from and within Turkey, covering Turkish Airlines, Pegasus, AJet and SunExpress as well as many international airlines. Search by city name (for example Istanbul or Antalya) or airport code (IST, SAW, AYT, LHR); if you are not sure which airport, BiletimiAl finds it for you.

BiletimiAl is operated by BD Seyahat ve Turizm Acentesi LTD ŞTİ, a TÜRSAB group A licensed travel agency (licence no. 13811). 24/7 support and phone booking: +90 850 532 63 83 · info@biletimial.com

— Türkçe —

BiletimiAl ile uçak biletlerini ChatGPT'den çıkmadan, giriş yapmadan ve hesap açmadan arayın; beğendiğiniz uçuşu biletimial.com'da satın alın.

Uçuşunuzu günlük dille, Türkçe ya da İngilizce sorun: tek yön veya gidiş-dönüş, istediğiniz tarih, yetişkin, çocuk ve bebek sayısı, ekonomi veya business. BiletimiAl güncel teklifleri arar ve en ucuzdan başlayarak listeler. Her teklifte havayolu, uçuş numarası, yerel kalkış ve varış saatleri, uçuş süresi, aktarma sayısı, bagaj hakkı ve bilet paketi yer alır; iade ve değişiklik koşulları ödeme öncesinde biletimial.com'da gösterilir.

Gösterilen fiyatlar tüm yolcular için vergiler ve hizmet bedeli dahil toplam fiyattır; biletimial.com'daki fiyatla aynıdır. Her teklifteki "Seç" düğmesi biletimial.com'da o uçuşun rezervasyon sayfasını açar; yolcu bilgilerini girip ödemeyi orada tamamlarsınız. Uygulama sohbet içinde rezervasyon yapmaz, ödeme almaz ve kişisel veri istemez. Teklifler yaklaşık 20 dakika ayrılır; süre dolarsa aynı arama güncel fiyatlarla açılır.

Türkiye'den, Türkiye'ye ve Türkiye içindeki uçuşlara odaklanır; Türk Hava Yolları, Pegasus, AJet ve SunExpress'in yanı sıra birçok uluslararası havayolunu kapsar. Şehir adıyla (örneğin İstanbul veya Antalya) ya da havalimanı koduyla (IST, SAW, AYT, LHR) arama yapabilirsiniz; havalimanından emin değilseniz BiletimiAl sizin için bulur.

BiletimiAl, TÜRSAB A Grubu yetkili seyahat acentesi (belge no 13811) BD Seyahat ve Turizm Acentesi LTD ŞTİ tarafından işletilir. 7/24 destek ve telefonla bilet: 0850 532 63 83 · info@biletimial.com

Round-trip flights from Ankara to Istanbul next weekend for 2 adults

positive.description: One-way domestic search by city names
positive.prompt: Find the cheapest flights from Istanbul to Antalya next Friday
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights. Returns offers cheapest first with airline, flight numbers, local times, stops, baggage, fare name and a select_url that opens the offer's booking page on biletimial.com, and states that prices are totals including taxes and service fee. Istanbul searches both IST and SAW.

positive.description: Turkish prompt, specific airport, relative date
positive.prompt: Sabiha Gökçen'den Ankara'ya önümüzdeki cumartesi en ucuz uçuşları göster
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights. Returns offers cheapest first with airline, flight numbers, local times, stops, baggage, fare name and a select_url that opens the offer's booking page on biletimial.com, and states that prices are totals including taxes and service fee. The origin is SAW and the destination ESB.

positive.description: Round-trip search with adults and a child
positive.prompt: Round-trip flights from Ankara to Istanbul for 2 adults and 1 child, leaving in two weeks and returning three days later
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights. Returns offers cheapest first with airline, flight numbers, local times, stops, baggage, fare name and a select_url that opens the offer's booking page on biletimial.com, and states that prices are totals including taxes and service fee. Each offer shows outbound and return legs; the price covers all three passengers and shows the per-adult price.

positive.prompt: Which airports serve Antalya and what are their codes?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_airports and lists Antalya Airport (AYT) and Gazipaşa-Alanya Airport (GZP) with their IATA codes.

positive.prompt: Flights from Istanbul to London on the 20th of next month for one adult
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights. Returns offers cheapest first with airline, flight numbers, local times, stops, baggage, fare name and a select_url that opens the offer's booking page on biletimial.com, and states that prices are totals including taxes and service fee. London searches its main airports (e.g. LHR, STN).

negative.description: Hotel booking is out of scope: the app only searches flights. Expected: the app is not called; the assistant explains it can only search flights.

negative.description: Changing or cancelling an existing ticket is out of scope: the app has no account access and no write actions. Expected: the app is not called; the assistant may point to BiletimiAl support (0850 532 63 83).
negative.prompt: Cancel my Turkish Airlines ticket with booking code ABC123

negative.description: Unrelated question. Expected: the app is not called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in Istanbul tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: The privacy policy link now points to the dedicated app privacy policy (https://biletimial.com/yapay-zeka/gizlilik), which lists the exact tool inputs and outputs, recipients, retention and user controls. MCP server: both tools now declare an outputSchema, the flight cards declare their widget domain and an empty CSP (no network requests; links open only biletimial.com), search_flights is marked openWorldHint true because it queries live airline offers through our ticketing provider, and the server instructions only describe how to use the tools. Tools stay read-only, no login.
